correctness.rationale: The two orbit equations are obtained by integrating the normalized half-plane vector fields. On the periodic right-hand component, \(X(Y)=\tfrac12e^{-2Y}(F(Y)^2-\kappa^2)>0\) for \(p<Y<q\), because \(F(Y)<\kappa<0\); the additional root with \(F(Y)=-\kappa\) lies on a different component, separated by \(X<0\). The crossing times are therefore \(q-p\) on each side. The monotonicity of \(F(y)=(y-1)e^y\) yields exactly two roots for \(\kappa\in(-1,0)\), and the Lambert-\(W\) branch formula plus endpoint expansions prove the period and both asymptotics.
